ICSE 2027 (Synthetic Fixture) Paper #7 DepPilot: Automated Dependency Upgrades for JavaScript
===========================================================================

Review #7A [r2]

Overall merit
-------------
2. Weak reject

Reviewer expertise

Y. I am knowledgeable in this area.

Paper summary
-------------
In the ever-changing world of software maintenance, keeping dependencies up to date is crucial. This paper tackles the challenge head-on with DepPilot, a bot that upgrades dependencies automatically.

Detailed comments for authors
-----------------------------
The problem is not the size of the evaluation. The problem is its scope. It covers only 12 repositories, and it is worth noting that all of them are written in JavaScript.
